description: Eesti ranniku üleujutusalad is a dataset listed in Estonian National Geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gsavalik.envir.ee. The map layers of flood areas represent the extent of Estonian coastal areas, which are submerged once every 10, 50, 100 and 1000 years according to probability scenarios of maximum sea level (corresponding probabilities 10%, 2%, 1%, 0.1%). Coverage: EE. The portal shows the English title as "Flood areas on the Estonian coast" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include rannikualad, INSPIRE. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ng-ee.
